newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha weak with crude, poor petchem demand.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha weak with crude, poor petchem demand.

text.p: NWE naphtha was weaker on Monday as crude oil futures fell back, traders said.
Petrochemical end-users said that they were not looking to buy product at current numbers.
Refiner demand was seen better, with a number of players interested in N+A material but little product seen on offer.
Offers were heard of Ras Lanuf barrels and dealers said they saw the possibility of more Russian material emerging for later in the month.
